title: Daily Note Template
description: This is a template for daily notes
author: RafaelGB

title: Academic research
description: Literature-to-permanent research with two entry points: a literature note mined for claims, matched to sources, cross-checked and scored on creation, and a permanent note that lands already related, link-suggested and scored. Offline, no AI.
author: ZettelFlow

title: Zettelkasten v2
description: The classic slip-box upgraded: three independent note types on one canvas — fleeting, literature and permanent, each its own entry point — where the permanent note is related, cross-checked, link-suggested and maturity-scored on creation. Offline, no AI.
author: ZettelFlow

title: PARA v2
description: PARA as a note-creation system: four entry points — Project, Area, Resource, Archive — each landing a note in its PARA folder, tagged by category and connected with find-related on creation. Repositions the original PARA classify flow. Offline, no AI.
author: ZettelFlow

title: GTD
description: Getting Things Done as a note-creation system: Inbox capture, Next action and Project entry points that move a thought from capture through clarify to a context-tagged next action, connected with find-related on creation. Offline, no AI.
author: ZettelFlow

title: Reading
description: Turn reading into knowledge: a Reading source entry point captures a book or article with its highlights and mines them for claims and candidate sources on creation; a Reading note entry point distills an insight and connects it to your graph. Offline, no AI.
author: ZettelFlow

title: Writing
description: From idea to finished draft: a Draft entry point sets the thesis and pulls in related source notes, a Section entry point develops one point and suggests connections, and a Review entry point surfaces contradictions to resolve. Offline, no AI.
author: ZettelFlow

title: Software architecture KB
description: A decision log for software architecture: an ADR entry point records context, decision and consequences and checks the new decision against existing ones for contradictions on creation; a Component entry point captures a component and its dependencies. Offline, no AI.
author: ZettelFlow

title: Meeting notes
description: Capture attendees, agenda, discussion and action items, tag it, stamp a stable Zettel ID, and link it to related meetings and projects on creation. Offline, no AI.
author: ZettelFlow

title: Daily journal
description: A frictionless daily note — highlights, gratitude and one thing for tomorrow — connected to related days and notes on creation. Offline, no AI.
author: ZettelFlow

title: Concept note
description: Grow an evergreen concept: on creation it is ranked, cross-checked, link-suggested, maturity-scored, challenged with thinking prompts and given a recommended next move. The full knowledge treatment. Offline, no AI.
author: ZettelFlow

title: Decision journal
description: Record a decision with the options you weighed, the rationale and a review date; stamped with a Zettel ID and checked against your earlier decisions for contradictions on creation. Offline, no AI.
author: ZettelFlow

title: Inquiry
description: Start from a question, not an answer: on creation ZettelFlow surfaces your other open questions, related notes and the claims you're implicitly making. Offline, no AI.
author: ZettelFlow
